profile.name: Vassel Goleyu
profile.headline: Attentive to even the smallest details, I have a genuine curiosity for the world around me. My thoughtful approach to challenges allows me to merge intelligence with creativity, resulting in innovative solutions that stand out. With a strong sense of preference and a one-of-a-kind perspective, I am passionate about making a meaningful impact in everything I do.
profile.bio: An Informatics student at Universitas Multimedia Nusantara, building useful digital experiences and bringing people together through student leadership and community care.

projects.title: Tomato Vision
projects.summary: A CNN trained from scratch in TensorFlow that grades tomato freshness: fresh, not fresh or rotten. The demo runs in the browser, so photos are never uploaded.
projects.problem: Explore visual freshness without sending photos to a server.
projects.outcome: Browser inference checked against Keras across 13 parity cases. Evaluation is still limited to a small dataset.
projects.alt: Tomato Vision: freshness classifier home, prediction and dataset screens

projects.title: BatchAman
projects.summary: An offline-first PWA for logging food batches. Its default thresholds are not yet expert-verified.
projects.problem: Keep a food batch’s journey recorded when connectivity is unreliable.
projects.outcome: Local batch timelines, QR labels, and CSV/JSON exports. Field validation remains pending.
projects.alt: BatchAman: today's dashboard and batch cards

projects.title: Ucup Menjelajahi Nusantara
projects.summary: A relaxed adventure across the Indonesian archipelago, with a travel journal, companions and minigames.
projects.problem: Turn an archipelago into a playful, explorable travel journal.
projects.outcome: Seven regions, four minigames, and saved progress. Keyboard and touch controls share the same adventure.
projects.alt: Ucup Menjelajahi Nusantara: welcome, companions and challenges screens

projects.title: Ngantriin
projects.summary: A digital restaurant queue for Android, with a diner app and a staff dashboard.
projects.problem: Connect diners and staff around the same restaurant queue.
projects.outcome: A diner app and staff dashboard, built with a shared Android stack.
projects.alt: Ngantriin: diner home, search and queue screens, and the restaurant staff dashboard

projects.title: JalanKita
projects.summary: An offline-first Android app for reporting road damage together, as a community.
projects.problem: Make community road-damage reports possible offline.
projects.outcome: An Android reporting workflow with light, dark, and large-font interfaces.
projects.alt: JalanKita: home screen in light, dark and large-font modes

projects.title: GEPREK!
projects.summary: A top-down 2D business and time-management game about running an ayam geprek stall.
projects.problem: Turn running a food stall into a time-management challenge.
projects.outcome: A playable 2D stall, service loop, and upgrade shop.
projects.alt: GEPREK!: title menu, the warung during service, and the upgrade shop

projects.title: CAPIRA
projects.summary: Measures capillary refill time with a smartphone camera, scores qSOFA and drafts referrals, all offline-first.
projects.problem: Explore offline access to assessment and referral tools.
projects.outcome: A camera-based research prototype, with qSOFA and referral drafts; not a clinically validated product.
projects.alt: CAPIRA: home, a running synthetic CRT simulation, and its result (simulation, not patient data)

projects.title: F&B Experience
projects.summary: One ordering experience for two venues: an artisanal dining room and a Japanese matcha and coffee bar.
projects.problem: Give two distinct venues a coherent ordering experience.
projects.outcome: Separate dining and matcha-bar interfaces within one React application.
projects.alt: F&B Experience: choose dining or drinks, then the food and matcha-bar homes

projects.title: BUNDA SIAGA
projects.summary: An offline aid for village health volunteers and midwives: danger signs in pregnancy and after birth, SMS referrals and an optional district-health server.
projects.problem: Keep maternal-health reference and referral tools accessible offline.
projects.outcome: An Android prototype with danger-sign prompts and SMS referrals; not evidence of clinical effectiveness.
projects.alt: BUNDA SIAGA: kader home, a danger-sign question, and the red priority result with its reasons
